backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing productivity tracking with distraction logging, activity switching, session management, app categorization, and burnout score calculation; includes migration support and persistent data structures for logs, switches, and session summaries.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module defining old and new actor state types for transitioning from focus session tracking to comprehensive distraction/activity monitoring; initializes empty maps for new data structures.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented features including manual session start, Pomodoro timer, distraction logging, app categorization, transition tracking, and session history with associated files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of frontend components and pages including Dashboard, LiveMonitor, AppCategorization, break pages, achievements, reports, and various UI components with their functionality descriptions.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI elements including sidebar, charts, and semantic tokens using OKLCH color space.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React application with viewport meta tag and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with protected and public routes, theme provider, and toast notifications; defines routes for dashboard, focus session, monitoring, categorization, breaks, achievements, and reports.
frontend/src/components/AchievementsBadg: Reusable achievement badge card component displaying title, description, image, unlock status, unlock date, and progress bar with conditional styling for locked/unlocked states.
frontend/src/components/AchievementsGall: Displays a grid of achievement badges with unlock status, progress, and share/export functionality. Shows count of unlocked achievements and allows sharing individual achievements to clipboard.
frontend/src/components/BlockScreen.tsx: Full-screen blocking interface that covers the viewport during productive sessions, displaying a 25-minute countdown timer, progress bar, and rotating productivity tips. Timer only advances when user maintains focus.
frontend/src/components/BurnoutScoreCard: Card component displaying current burnout score (0-100) with visual indicators (color, icon, progress bar) for low/medium/high fatigue levels and contextual descriptions.
frontend/src/components/BurnoutTrendsCha: Line chart showing historical burnout scores over the last 10 sessions with reference lines at thresholds (30, 60) for low/medium/high levels.
frontend/src/components/BurnoutWarning.t: Bottom-right notification card that appears when burnout reaches medium threshold (30+), suggesting desk recovery breaks with dismissible UI and entrance/exit animations.
frontend/src/components/DailyRecommendat: Card displaying a numbered list of personalized daily recommendations to improve focus, rendered as individual items with index badges.
frontend/src/components/DistractionLogMo: Modal dialog for manually logging distractions with fields for source name, category (productive/distracting/neutral), type (social media, work app, etc.), and optional notes.
frontend/src/components/DistractionTrend: Line chart showing average distractions per session grouped by day over the last 7 days, aggregating session data into daily averages.
frontend/src/components/DistractionWarni: Bottom-right notification card that appears when frequent tab switching is detected (showing switch count), encouraging focused work with smooth entrance/exit animations and dismissible UI.
frontend/src/components/DistractiveConte: Displays a full-screen lock overlay when a focus session is active and the user has exceeded violation limits, showing remaining time with a progress bar and motivational messaging.
Wraps content and applies a grayscale filter with a warning overlay when the user is on a distractive route during an active focus session with violations.
frontend/src/components/DistructiveVisit: Shows dismissible warning alerts at the bottom-right corner with escalating severity (gentle reminder, focus check-in, final warning) based on the number of distractive site visits.
frontend/src/components/DurationAnalysis: Displays a pie chart of session duration distribution (sustained focus, brief browsing, habit checking) and lists habitual distractions with visit counts.
frontend/src/components/FocusLockOverlay: Renders a full-screen modal overlay with a lock icon, countdown timer, progress bar, and explanation when a focus lock is active to help users break distraction cycles.
frontend/src/components/FocusSessionSumm: Displays a summary card after a focus session showing duration, distraction count, calculated focus score with progress bar, and performance feedback.
Shows the user's consecutive days of completed focus sessions with a flame icon, badge, and milestone-based motivational messages.
frontend/src/components/GreyscaleOverlay: Applies a progressive grayscale backdrop filter overlay based on burnout intensity level, increasing from 0% to 50% as burnout reaches high thresholds.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main application layout component with navigation sidebar, user profile dropdown with Internet Identity authentication, and quick action buttons for desk recovery and walk breaks.
frontend/src/components/MetricsCard.tsx: Reusable card component for displaying a metric with title, value, icon, and optional trend indicator showing increase or decrease from previous period.
frontend/src/components/PatternCard.tsx: Displays a single pattern card with title, description, trend text, and a visual indicator (trending up/down icon) styled based on whether the pattern is positive or negative.
frontend/src/components/PeriodicReport.t: Renders a periodic report view with time period selection (week/month), export functionality, and displays positive patterns and areas for improvement using PatternCard components.
frontend/src/components/ProductivityScor: Displays an overall productivity score with a circular progress indicator, color-coded label (Excellent/Good/Fair/Needs Improvement), and contextual feedback message based on the score value.
frontend/src/components/ProductivityTren: Renders a line chart showing weekly productivity trend data with focus scores over time using Recharts library.
frontend/src/components/ProtectedRoute.t: Authentication wrapper component that checks Internet Identity authentication status and redirects unauthenticated users to login, showing a loading spinner during initialization.
frontend/src/components/RecoveryQualityC: Displays a pie chart showing the breakdown of restorative vs non-restorative break time with percentages and explanatory text about break quality types.
frontend/src/components/SessionHistoryTa: Renders a table of past focus sessions showing date/time, duration, distractions count, switches count, and a color-coded score badge with loading and empty states.
Modal dialog that prompts users to categorize their site visit as either productive or distractive when returning from being away.
frontend/src/components/TransitionMatrix: Displays the top 10 most common activity switching pathways with visual intensity based on frequency, showing transitions between applications with arrow indicators.
frontend/src/components/TransitionPatter: Shows common interruption patterns (repeated activity transitions occurring 3+ times) in a card format with arrow indicators between activities.
frontend/src/components/ValidationMetric: React component that displays real-time validation metrics for app switching behavior, including total switches, frequency rates, distraction score breakdown, and a detailed history table with timestamps and durations.
frontend/src/hooks/useAchievements.ts: Hook that manages a static list of user achievements with unlock status, progress tracking, and a share function to copy achievement text to clipboard.
Hook that simulates random app switching activity with localStorage persistence, tracking current app, category, switch history, and calculating switching frequency metrics (per minute/hour).
frontend/src/hooks/useActivityTransition: Hook that records activity transitions between apps to the backend actor, fetches switch history, and analyzes repeated transition patterns to identify top interruptions (3+ occurrences).
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, automatically invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useApplications.ts: Hook that manages application list with categories (productive/distracting/neutral), syncing with backend actor for CRUD operations and initializing with defaults if backend is empty.
frontend/src/hooks/useBlockingLogic.ts: Hook implementing progressive warning system that blocks the screen after 2 dismissals, requiring a 25-minute productive session with low switching frequency to unlock, with localStorage persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useBreakAnalytics.ts: Hook that provides static break analytics data, calculating percentages of restorative vs non-restorative break time from hardcoded values.
frontend/src/hooks/useBreakTimer.ts: Hook that manages break timer countdown for desk recovery or walk breaks, tracking start time and duration but no longer recording to backend (old recordBreak method removed).
frontend/src/hooks/useBreathingAnimation: Hook that controls breathing exercise animation phases (inhale/hold/exhale/rest) with corresponding scale values, cycling through a 16-second breathing pattern when active.
frontend/src/hooks/useBurnoutMonitor.ts: Monitors burnout index (0-100) based on real-time focus metrics like switches per minute and distraction score, with thresholds at 30 (warning) and 60 (critical). Persists state to localStorage and allows dismissing warnings that reappear if burnout increases by 10+ points.
frontend/src/hooks/useBurnoutScore.ts: Calculates burnout score from current session stats or recent session summaries using focus ratio minus switch and distraction penalties. Categorizes score as low (<30), medium (30-60), or high (>60).
frontend/src/hooks/useDashboardData.ts: Returns mock dashboard data including focus time, distraction time, switching frequency, productivity score, weekly burnout trend, and recommendations. No longer connects to backend methods.
Manages distraction logging modal and calls backend actor to log distractions with source, category, type, and description. Tracks and persists distraction count to localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useDistractionWarning: Manages escalating warning levels (0-3) based on destructive visit count with thresholds at 2, 3, and 5 visits. Persists warning state to localStorage and allows dismissing warnings that reappear at higher levels.
frontend/src/hooks/useDurationAnalysis.t: Analyzes session durations to classify as sustained focus (25+ min), brief browsing (5-25 min), or habit checking (<5 min), and identifies habitual distractions from repeated short visits. Uses distraction logs and session summaries from queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useFocusLock.ts: Implements focus lock with escalating durations (5-60 minutes) based on destructive visit count, activating at 6+ visits or warning level 3. Manages countdown timer and persists lock state to localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useFocusMonitor.ts: Monitors browser tab/window focus events to track distraction metrics including switch count, switches per minute/hour, time away, and distraction score. Privacy-focused: only tracks focus state and timestamps, not content or keystrokes.
Manages Pomodoro-style work and break session timers with start, pause, resume, and reset controls. Persists timer state to localStorage and provides formatted time display.
frontend/src/hooks/useFocusSessionViolat: Tracks navigation violations during focus sessions (productive-to-distractive route switches), applies grayscale mode penalty after 3 violations, and persists state to localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useFocusStatistics.ts: Calculates focus statistics from session summaries including focus streak, total focus time, productive visit ratio, and weekly trend data.
frontend/src/hooks/useFocusTimer.ts: Provides a simple timer that counts seconds while active and formats the duration as MM:SS.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context with login/logout functionality, identity management, and status tracking using DFINITY AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching session summaries, distraction logs, activity switches, current session stats, and app categories from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useReportData.ts: Returns mock positive and negative behavioral patterns for reporting, with a simulated loading state based on the selected time period.
frontend/src/hooks/useSessionHistory.ts: Aggregates session summaries, top distractions, and distraction logs from queries, sorting sessions by recency and providing the 10 most recent.
Tracks site visits (productive/distractive) when user returns after being away 5+ seconds, persists visit data to localStorage, and manages a categorization prompt.
frontend/src/hooks/useWalkBreakTimer.ts: Manages a countdown timer for walk breaks with start/pause/reset controls, plays an alert sound when complete, and calculates progress percentage.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm, supportive color palette for light and dark modes, including primary, secondary, accent, and chart colors.
frontend/src/lib/copyConstants.ts: Centralized copy/text constants for the application including app name, dashboard messages, warning thresholds, break instructions, and focus guardian notifications.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/Achievements.tsx: Page component displaying user achievements and productivity milestones using the AchievementsGallery component.
frontend/src/pages/AppCategorization.tsx: Page for managing application and website categorization (productive/distracting/neutral) with add, edit, and delete functionality organized by category.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page showing burnout score, activity metrics, session statistics, quick action buttons for starting focus sessions, and navigation to session history.
frontend/src/pages/DeskRecovery.tsx: Guided breathing exercise page with animated breathing circle, timer controls, and step-by-step instructions for desk recovery breaks.
frontend/src/pages/FocusSession.tsx: Focus session timer page with preset and custom work/break durations, distraction logging, activity transition tracking, and session summary display upon completion.
frontend/src/pages/LiveMonitor.tsx: Displays real-time activity monitoring with current application tracking, switching metrics (count, per minute/hour), time away, and distraction score using both simulated and real focus monitor data.
frontend/src/pages/Login.tsx: Login page component that handles Internet Identity authentication, displays app features, and redirects authenticated users to the dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/Reports.tsx: Simple page wrapper that renders the PeriodicReport component for displaying behavioral productivity reports.
frontend/src/pages/SessionHistory.tsx: Comprehensive analytics page showing completed focus sessions, distraction trends, burnout patterns, duration analysis, transition matrices, and top distractions with detailed metrics.
frontend/src/pages/WalkBreak.tsx: Walk break timer page allowing users to set and track break durations (5-60 minutes) with play/pause controls, progress visualization, and quick preset buttons.
frontend/src/types/index.ts: TypeScript type definitions for core domain models including Application, ContextSwitch, FocusSession, FocusSessionViolation, and FocusSessionState.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom theme extensions for colors (using OKLCH), border radius, shadows, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file for a web-based focus tracker application with React frontend and Motoko backend on Internet Computer. Documents 8 existing features including manual session control, Pomodoro timer, distraction logging, activity classification, transition tracking, analytics dashboard, and burnout scoring algorithms.
